_about: The sections of the Senate-passed text (data/bill/substitute_sections.json) that each commentary, report or statement on the coverage list discusses. Each section carries the item's own words about it, copied from the page and checked by tools/check_quotes.py. `none`: the item discusses the bill only as a whole. `unread`: the page could not be read by script or by hand. Every commentary, report and statement dated on or after the text's release sits in one of the three lists, or links to sections through data/claims.json or data/takes.json (tools/build.py).
